question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

He was quite **__violent__** in his behaviour.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Gentle."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence talks about someone's behaviour being violent.
 
• The word** 'violent'** means using physical force to hurt or harm someone or something. (जिसमें किसी को चोट पहुँचाने या मारने के लिए भौतिक शक्ति का प्रयोग हो, हिंसक; हिंसात्‍मक, हिंसापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: ***The demonstration started peacefully but later turned **violent**__.*
 
 
 
• The word **'gentle'** means being kind and mild in nature. ((व्‍यक्ति) दयालु और शांत; बिना चोट पहुँचाए कोमलता से व्‍यवहार करने वाला; सौम्‍य)
 __
 
• **Example: ***‘I'll try and be as **gentle**__ as I can,’ said the dentist.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym for the underlined word is **'gentle.'**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Crazy**: This word means being mentally unstable or insane. (सनकी, पागल, मूर्ख)
 
• **Aggressive**: This word means being forceful and assertive. (लड़ाका, हमलावर, झगड़ालू, आक्रामक)
 
• **Savage**: This word means being cruel and brutal. (अति निर्दय, हिंसक या बर्बर)
